title: fix: show team creation license errors

files.patch:
@@ -0,0 +1,53 @@ +import { createTestingPinia } from '@pinia/testing' +import { enableAutoUnmount, flushPromises, shallowMount } from '@vue/test-utils' +import { afterEach, expect, test, vi } from 'vitest' + +import client from '../../../../../frontend/src/api/client.ts' +import teamTypesApi from '../../../../../frontend/src/api/teamTypes.js' +import CreateTeam from '../../../../../frontend/src/pages/team/create.vue' +import Alerts from '../../../../../frontend/src/services/alerts.js' + +enableAutoUnmount(afterEach) +afterEach(() => vi.restoreAllMocks()) + +async function submitTeam (error) { + vi.spyOn(CreateTeam.methods, 'checkSlug').mockImplementation(() => {}) + vi.spyOn(teamTypesApi, 'getTeamTypes').mockResolvedValue({ types: [{ id: 'type1', name: 'Starter', properties: {} }] }) + const post = vi.spyOn(client, 'post').mockRejectedValue({ response: { status: 400, data: { error } } }) + const wrapper = shallowMount(CreateTeam, { + global: { + plugins: [createTestingPinia({ createSpy: vi.fn, initialState: { 'account-settings': { features: { billing: false } } } })], + stubs: { + 'ff-page': { template: '
' }, + 'ff-page-header': true, + 'ff-loading': true, + 'ff-tile-selection': true, + 'ff-tile-selection-option': true, + 'ff-toggle-switch': true, + 'ff-button': true + }, + mocks: { $route: { query: {} }, $router: { push: vi.fn() } } + } + }) + await flushPromises() + await wrapper.setData({ input: { name: 'Development', slug: 'development' } }) + wrapper.vm.createTeam() + await flushPromises() + expect(post).toHaveBeenCalledWith('/api/v1/teams/', expect.objectContaining({ name: 'Development', slug: 'development' })) + expect(wrapper.vm.loading).toBe(false) + return wrapper +} + +test('shows the license limit error returned by team creation', async () => { + const emit = vi.spyOn(Alerts, 'emit') + const wrapper = await submitTeam('Error: license limit reached') + expect(emit).toHaveBeenCalledWith('Creating Team would exceed license limits', 'warning') + expect(wrapper.vm.input.slugError).toBe('') +}) + +test('keeps duplicate slug errors on the slug field', async () => { + const emit = vi.spyOn(Alerts, 'emit') + const wrapper = await submitTeam('slug must be unique') + expect(wrapper.vm.input.slugError).toBe('Slug already in use') + expect(emit).not.toHaveBeenCalled() +})
